<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>

Any authenticated platform user may scan the unit's own OSPI code to open a time-boxed maintenance session (default 30 minutes, slides forward on each event logged). No owner-side approval step. Once the session lapses, logging maintenance requires scanning in again. Returns the productId/unitId to call the normal POST.../serialized-units/:unitId/events with. NOTE (direct product-owner scoping): OSPI supplies these endpoints only — the actual code scanning (camera/barcode-reader UI) is built into each professional's own field-service software, not by this platform. A dedicated client SDK wrapping this scan → event-log flow is a real, not-yet-built follow-up (see BACKLOG.md) — integrators currently call the raw REST endpoints directly.
